svg.title: Timeline of the third run, attempts 251 to 500, and the agents that made them
svg.desc: Claude Code agents, all on Claude Opus 5.5, from November 21 to 23, 2026 (UTC): 36 rounds of seven builders (five in the last) and an integrator, one pull request each, and the output tokens of each pull request. Drawn for this repo from the session's transcripts.
svg.text: 250 more attempts, 286 agents, one model: Claude Opus 5.5
Each bar is one agent, from its first message to its last. Times in UTC, November 21 to 23, 2026.
Output tokens per pull request (all of its agents)
Rounds 50 to 84 had seven builders and an integrator, one pull request each; round 85 had five builders, A to E.
Builders committed locally in their own worktrees; the integrator merged them in the order G, F, E, D, A, B, C and opened the round's pull request.
Not drawn: the orchestrator, which ran the whole session and started every agent, and the agent that made the final history pull request.
